Christian Leaders Institute / College

Free Christian-focused learning with a separate academic-transcript pathway. College admission or verification requirements apply to eligible credit records.

Browse Christian Leaders courses

Choose a degree plan to see where specific courses fit.

Study format
Online and self-paced. Course, admissions and verification requirements determine when an eligible transcript can be issued.
Pricing
Learning access is free. Outgoing transcript processing is $75 USD for students without a CLI degree or $30 USD for CLI graduates; additional pathway fees may apply.
Assessments
Requirements differ between free learning and the academic pathway. Archived Liberty transfer pairs exist; current exact course approvals are not yet established in DegreeSteps.
Credit type
CLI institution-issued transcript pathway. CLI discloses ABHE candidate, or pre-accreditation, status; this is separate from full accreditation or an ACE recommendation.
Transfer and enrollment details

How the credit works

CLI institution-issued transcript pathway. CLI discloses ABHE candidate, or pre-accreditation, status; this is separate from full accreditation or an ACE recommendation.

Before enrolling

  • Start with your degree plan to see the proposed receiving course or requirement.
  • Review any course-specific enrollment, equipment or assessment steps shown in your plan.
  • University decisions about your own records remain separate from published course matches.
